title: I just released "My Summer Love: Memories"! It replaces the traditional A/B dialogue options of visual novels with a dynamic AI character
author: Soulshellgames
selftext:
[My summer love: memories](https://reddit.com/link/1u1ev2u/video/nc7iallo3b6h1/player)

My game, My Summer Love: Memories, is now available! Its core mechanic is based on a dialogue system. Traditional visual novels force you to follow rigid paths (A/B). Thanks to the implementation of an AI system, the character doesn't just follow a static script, but generates dynamic dialogue. This dialogue is closely tied to the game's story and the player's words. I'm proud of the result. If you enjoy innovative stories with a touch of romance and nostalgia, check it out!

Available now on: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/3794600/My\_Summer\_Love\_Memories/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3794600/My_Summer_Love_Memories/)

I'd love to hear your feedback, especially on the AI ​​integration and how it changes your immersion compared to conventional visual novels!

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: What's with the flappy bird clone screenshot?

replies.author: Soulshellgames
replies.body: It's a game mechanic that simulates a state of nervousness. If you bump into a pipe, it automatically generates an awkward phrase from the player. Although it hasn't been very popular so far, it's optional.

replies.author: kal101246
replies.body: I agree with the other commenter, it feels out of place in the game.

comments.author: Significant-Big-7022
comments.body: How long did it take to make?

replies.author: Soulshellgames
replies.body: Exactly one year using mostly C++ with the LlamaCpp and SFML libraries. The LLM is Gemma 3. I made the images and videos with Google Nano Banana 2 and Kling 2.6 (I had previously experimented with BERT, GPT2, GPTNEO and onnxruntime to create a game with Unreal Engine).
